creatingNewCreature: 1. Copy the creature template structure (id, name, type, role, description, typePassive, tiers)
3. Fill baseStats (health, attack, speed) - tier 2 should be ~1.5x, tier 3 should be ~2.25x
5. Each ability has: name, id, trigger, description, effects array
6. Effects array can have 1-3 effects, but should all serve the same core ability fantasy
7. Keep abilities aligned with the trigger x effect matrix

scalingGuideline.speed: Usually constant (1-3 range), or +1 per tier max

abilityScopingRules: Keep the core fantasy consistent across all 3 tiers
Tier 1 = baseline effect with basic numbers
Tier 2 = same effect, stronger numbers (usually 1.5-2x scaling)
Tier 3 = same effect, strongest numbers (usually 2-3x tier 1)
Do NOT add extra effects between tiers - just scale the numbers
Do NOT change the trigger between tiers - same trigger across all 3
